## About This Portfolio

The goal of this portfolio is not only to present finished visualizations, but also to document the decisions behind them: how data are collected, transformed, represented, interpreted, and evaluated.

The projects emphasize clear visual communication, reproducible analysis, responsible use of data, and critical interpretation of evidence.
